milestone: Checked CPU int8/uint8/int16/uint16 tensor construction, elementwise arithmetic and retained local workers

implementation.capabilities: Separate tensor elementwise capability admits all ten CPU numeric types without enabling narrow reductions/matmul/numeric casts or GPU operations
implementation.construction: Ranked/rank-zero literals and typed empties, scalar lifting, structural array/tensor construction, indexing, reshape and shape queries reuse existing width-aware lowering
implementation.arithmetic: Existing checked CPU integer lowering reused unchanged for tensor/tensor and scalar/tensor arithmetic, signed division/remainder, checked unsigned underflow/negation and exact 1/2-byte result cells
implementation.workers_records: Existing type-specific tensor layouts, retained snapshots, cached observations and record tensor field ownership reused unchanged in the CPU/task backend and allocator/scheduler
implementation.operation_gates: Semantic and forged-IR numeric cast checks require both source and destination tensor types to be qualified; reductions/matmul keep the existing six-type gate
implementation.diagnostics_display: Typed IR literal/unary/binary labels derive signedness/width from type metadata; CLI tensor admission and existing decimal element display extend to narrow types
implementation.limits: CPU construction, elementwise and structural operations only; narrow reductions/matmul/tensor numeric casts and GPU execution remain gated. Shared-storage optimization, CUDA, distributed execution and public C/C++ integration remain separate work

coverage: All 82 frontend checks freshly rebuilt, plus syntax/semantic/placement/continuation, numeric descriptions and storage/display guards; exact typed-IR narrow width/signedness labels and forged cast gate checks

Shared width-parameterized integer tensor harness: boundary and deterministic random operands, five binary operators with tensor/tensor and either scalar side, unary operations, ranks 0/1/2/3, explicit/dynamic literal shapes and refined calls

Strided/padded borrowed views, aliasing, immutable inputs, shape faults, size/byte overflow, allocator failure, first/late arithmetic faults, source locations, retained result leases and active/pre-entry cancellation

Narrow task payloads and layouts with one/four workers, nested/cached awaits, scalar/rank-one/matrix/rank-three/empty results, wrong-layout guarded observations, cancellation/deadlines/admission, scheduler allocation failures at positions 1..12 and data retained after invocation/scheduler destruction
Record tensor fields with scalar metadata, immutable updates, retained original/output arrays and source allocation failures at positions 1..20; checked arithmetic recovery

Array/tensor structural construction, reshape, flattening, signed/unsigned tensor indices, shape/length query workers, mixed narrow tensor types and CLI dimensional/empty output; compiled documentation example
Five rejection probes per type for reduction, matmul, casts in/out and Metal admission preserve existing executable/LLVM/MLIR output files

Both signednesses of the shared 64-bit tensor and tensor-worker suites rerun in all four variants; existing tensor conversion smoke tests, full narrow-array suites, CLI collection entry suites and Metal CLI rerun
qualification.scope: Focused qualification, not full-suite coverage. No production edits after final qualification started. An early test-only Metal rejection command incorrectly combined CPU IR output flags with the Metal target; removed those conflicting flags while retaining sentinel artifact checks. Existing frontend invalid-type fixtures were moved to genuinely unsupported numeric identities as narrow tensor values became supported. JS prototype and website untouched.
